title: Fix KeyError when 'cache' key is missing from config.yaml
body:
Fixes #482.

`load_config` in myapp/config.py assumed `config['cache']` always exists. This makes it optional and defaults to a disabled cache when absent, matching the documented behavior in docs/config.md.

Added a regression test in tests/test_config.py that loads a config file without the cache key.
diff:
diff --git a/myapp/config.py b/myapp/config.py
index 1234567..89abcde 100644
--- a/myapp/config.py
+++ b/myapp/config.py
@@ -39,7 +39,7 @@ def load_config(path):
     config = yaml.safe_load(open(path))
-    cache_ttl = config['cache']['ttl']
+    cache_cfg = config.get('cache', {'enabled': False})
+    cache_ttl = cache_cfg.get('ttl', 0)
     return Config(cache_ttl=cache_ttl)
diff --git a/tests/test_config.py b/tests/test_config.py
index 2345678..9abcdef 100644
--- a/tests/test_config.py
+++ b/tests/test_config.py
@@ -10,6 +10,12 @@ def test_load_config_with_cache():
     config = load_config('fixtures/with_cache.yaml')
     assert config.cache_ttl == 300
+
+def test_load_config_without_cache_key():
+    config = load_config('fixtures/no_cache.yaml')
+    assert config.cache_ttl == 0
